search_text: published ZDI-06-003 ZDI-CAN-009 Ipswitch Collaboration Suite Code Execution Vulnerability 2006-03-13 CVE-2005-3526 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2005-3526 ['Ipswitch'] ['IMail'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Ipswitch Collaboration Suite. title: Ipswitch Collaboration Suite Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Ipswitch Collaboration Suite. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. This specific flaw exists within the IMAP daemon. A lack of bounds checking during the parsing of long arguments to the FETCH verb can result in an exploitable buffer overflow.
